summary: Iteration 164 - Merchant Portal Bug Fix VERIFIED. The fix for the reported 'Das kann nicht öffnen' (Cannot open) bug is confirmed working. The merchant-portal router was successfully registered in router_registry.py, and the dashboard API now returns public_slug. All test scenarios pass.

GET /api/merchant/public/test-store-gmbh - PASS (200 OK, returns business data with products/promotions)
Dashboard tab shows revenue stats (Heute, Diese Woche, Diesen Monat, Gesamt) - PASS
Quick Action 'Öffentliche Seite' visible and clickable - PASS
Ecosystem tab shows 'Public Merchant Page' card with slug - PASS

merchant_portal_ui.details: Merchant Portal page loads correctly at /merchant-portal with Dashboard, Ökosystem, Wachstum, Finanzen tabs

public_page_quick_action.details: 'Öffentliche Seite' Quick Action visible in Dashboard tab and navigates to Public Merchant Page

ecosystem_public_page_card.details: Ecosystem tab shows 'Public Merchant Page' card with URL 'bidblitz.ae/business/test-store-gmbh' and 'Öffnen' button

public_merchant_page.details: Public Merchant Page loads showing 'Test Store GmbH', products (Bananen), and promotions (Free Send, Payment Cashback)

fix_verification.original_bug: User reported 'Das kann nicht öffnen' (Cannot open) for Public Merchant Page card in Merchant Portal
fix_verification.root_cause: 1) routes.merchant_portal was not registered in router_registry.py causing /api/merchant-portal/dashboard to return 404. 2) Dashboard response was missing public_slug field needed for navigation
fix_verification.fix_applied: 1) Added ('routes.merchant_portal', 'router') to router_registry.py line 47. 2) Added public_slug to dashboard response in merchant_portal.py
fix_verification.verification: Both API and UI tests confirm the fix works correctly

critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correctly implemented - merchant_portal router is now registered in router_registry.py
public_slug is properly returned from both merchant_profiles and merchants collections with fallback logic
Frontend correctly uses public_slug for navigation to /business/{slug}
seed_data_creation: None - used existing seeded merchant account
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 164 verified the Merchant Portal bug fix. The 'Öffentliche Seite' (Public Page) feature now works correctly. Merchant can navigate to their public business page via Quick Actions in Dashboard or via the Public Merchant Page card in Ecosystem tab. The public_slug 'test-store-gmbh' is correctly returned by the API and used for navigation.
